author: J.W. COOKE Keys
title: Lady Conchs blow past Lady 'Fins in Middle Keys - NewsBreak
text:
By J.W. COOKE Keys ,
5 hours ago
Breaking the game open with a five-run second inning after an early home run, the Key West High softball team rolled past the Marathon High softball team 11-0 on Tuesday, March 23, on the Middle Keys campus.
Jumping out quickly, Key West struck in the first when Lilee Gage blasted a two-run home run to center field for a 2-0 lead.
Pouring it on in the second, the Lady Conchs sent runs across in waves. Maciee Gage singled home a run, Lucy Katz followed with an RBI single, Aaliyah McLeod doubled to center, Shylo Sanchez ripped a run-scoring double down the right field line, and a Marathon error capped the inning as Key West built a 7-0 advantage.
Adding on, Key West tacked on a run in the fourth and three more in the fifth to extend the lead to 11-0, finishing with 11 runs on 13 hits.
Dominating in the circle, Brianna Brenner allowed two hits through four shutout innings while striking out seven and walking one. Ryleigh Harnish worked a scoreless inning in relief, giving up one hit and striking out two.
Leading a balanced attack, Katz, Sanchez, McLeod and Kaleya Cervantes each collected two hits. Katz and Lilee Gage drove in two runs apiece, while McLeod added two doubles.
For Marathon, Maeve Merryman recorded two of the Lady Fins’ three hits, going 2 for 3 from the leadoff spot.
Marathon pitchers allowed 13 hits and 11 runs, eight earned, and the Lady Fins committed four errors.
Key West returns to action Friday, March 27, at home against Neumann at the KWHC Back Yard.
